exercises.title: Warm-up — Classify trend verbs
exercises.instruction: Drag each verb into the correct trend group.

items.explanation: "rise" mang nghĩa tăng. Dùng được cho mọi mức độ.
"climb" mang nghĩa tăng. Thường là tăng dần, đều đặn.
"surge" mang nghĩa tăng. Tăng vọt, đột ngột.
"rocket" mang nghĩa tăng. Tăng rất nhanh và mạnh.
"plunge" mang nghĩa giảm. Giảm mạnh và đột ngột.
"dip" mang nghĩa giảm. Giảm nhẹ, thường chỉ trong thời gian ngắn.
"plummet" mang nghĩa giảm. Lao dốc rất mạnh.
"decline" mang nghĩa giảm. Giảm dần, trang trọng.
"level off" = chững lại, ổn định sau một giai đoạn tăng/giảm.
"remain unchanged" = giữ nguyên, không đổi.
"hit a plateau" = chạm mức bình nguyên, đứng yên.
"stay stable" = duy trì ổn định.
"fluctuate" = dao động lên xuống.
"oscillate" = dao động qua lại giữa hai mức.
"vary" = thay đổi, lên xuống không đều.
"be volatile" = biến động mạnh, thất thường.

exercises.title: Quick practice — Past simple forms (V2)
exercises.instruction: Write the past simple form (V2) of each verb.

items.prompt: rise
items.explanation: rise là động từ bất quy tắc → V2 là "rose". (rise – rose – risen)

items.prompt: increase
items.explanation: increase là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: increased. (tận cùng -e chỉ thêm -d)

items.prompt: grow
items.explanation: grow là động từ bất quy tắc → V2 là "grew". (grow – grew – grown)

items.prompt: climb
items.explanation: climb là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: climbed.

items.prompt: go up
items.explanation: go là bất quy tắc → went; cụm động từ giữ nguyên tiểu từ: went up.

items.prompt: jump
items.explanation: jump là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: jumped.

items.prompt: rocket
items.explanation: rocket là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: rocketed. (trọng âm ở âm đầu nên không gấp đôi t)

items.prompt: surge
items.explanation: surge là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: surged. (tận cùng -e chỉ thêm -d)

items.prompt: peak
items.explanation: peak là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: peaked.

items.prompt: hit
items.explanation: hit là bất quy tắc, ba dạng giống nhau: hit – hit – hit.

items.prompt: fall
items.explanation: fall là động từ bất quy tắc → V2 là "fell". (fall – fell – fallen; đừng nhầm với "felt")

items.prompt: drop
items.explanation: drop: một âm tiết, kết thúc phụ âm–nguyên âm–phụ âm → gấp đôi p: dropped.

items.prompt: decline
items.explanation: decline là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: declined. (tận cùng -e chỉ thêm -d)

items.prompt: plunge
items.explanation: plunge là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: plunged. (tận cùng -e chỉ thêm -d)

items.prompt: plummet
items.explanation: plummet: trọng âm ở âm đầu nên không gấp đôi t → plummeted.

items.prompt: dip
items.explanation: dip: một âm tiết, kết thúc phụ âm–nguyên âm–phụ âm → gấp đôi p: dipped.

items.prompt: level off
items.explanation: level off → levelled off (Anh–Anh gấp đôi l; Anh–Mỹ viết leveled off).

items.prompt: fluctuate
items.explanation: fluctuate là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: fluctuated. (tận cùng -e chỉ thêm -d)

items.prompt: remain
items.explanation: remain là động từ có quy tắc → thêm -ed: remained.

items.prompt: bottom
items.explanation: bottom (out) dùng như động từ có quy tắc → bottomed.

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Choose the word that matches the degree of change
exercises.instruction: Choose the adjective or adverb that best matches the data described.

items.prompt: Sales went from 100 to 105 units. → a ____ increase
items.explanation: Chỉ tăng 5 đơn vị → mức rất nhỏ.

items.prompt: The population fell from 8 million to 2 million. → ____
items.explanation: Giảm 75% → giảm cực mạnh.

items.prompt: The figure stayed at 40% for ten years. → ____
items.explanation: Không thay đổi suốt giai đoạn.

items.prompt: The price went up and down many times. → ____
items.explanation: Lên xuống liên tục = dao động.

items.prompt: The number rose from 200 to 800 in one year. → increased ____
items.explanation: Gấp 4 lần trong 1 năm → tăng đột biến.

items.prompt: After rising for years, the figure stopped changing. → ____
items.explanation: “level off” = ổn định lại sau khi tăng hoặc giảm.

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Rank by degree
exercises.instruction: Put the words in order from WEAKEST to STRONGEST.

items.explanation: Thang mức độ: minimal → slight → moderate → significant/substantial/considerable → dramatic → enormous.
Thang tốc độ / độ dốc: gradual → moderate → rapid → sharp → steep.

exercises.title: Extra practice — Peaks and troughs
exercises.instruction: Fill in the missing word to complete each phrase describing the highest / lowest point.

items.prompt: The number of car users peaked ____ 10 million in 2010.
items.explanation: peak (v) + AT + số liệu.

items.prompt: Internet usage reached a peak ____ 85% in 2020.
items.explanation: peak (n) → a peak OF + số liệu.

items.prompt: After several years of steady growth, the figure hit the ____ point of 2,000 tonnes in 2015.
items.explanation: hit the highest point of…

items.prompt: After falling sharply for three years, sales hit a ____ of 500 units in 2018.
items.explanation: hit a low of + số liệu.

items.prompt: The unemployment rate ____ a bottom of 2% in 2005.
items.explanation: reach a bottom of…

items.prompt: After falling for months, oil prices ____ at 30 USD per barrel in 2016.
items.explanation: bottom (v) + AT + số liệu.

items.prompt: Following a long decline, the figure hit the ____ point of 1 million in 1999.
items.explanation: hit the lowest point of…

items.prompt: The graph shows a ____ of almost 95,000 USD before the decline.
items.explanation: “a peak / a high of…” đều dùng được.

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Turn the verb into a noun
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each sentence using the structure: There was a/an + adjective + noun + in …

items.prompt: The number of tourists increased sharply in 2010.
sampleAnswers: There was a sharp increase in the number of tourists in 2010.
items.promptVi: Số lượng khách du lịch đã tăng mạnh vào năm 2010.
items.explanation: Động từ "increased sharply" → "a sharp increase in" (trạng từ → tính từ, động từ → danh từ, đi với giới từ in).

items.prompt: Car sales fell slightly between 2015 and 2016.
sampleAnswers: There was a slight fall in car sales between 2015 and 2016.
items.promptVi: Doanh số bán ô tô đã giảm nhẹ trong khoảng thời gian từ năm 2015 đến năm 2016.
items.explanation: "fell slightly" → "a slight fall in".

items.prompt: The unemployment rate fluctuated wildly.
sampleAnswers: There was a wild fluctuation in the unemployment rate.
items.promptVi: Tỷ lệ thất nghiệp đã trải qua những biến động mạnh.
items.explanation: "fluctuated wildly" → "a wild fluctuation in".

items.prompt: Rice exports grew substantially over the period.
sampleAnswers: There was a substantial growth in rice exports over the period.
items.promptVi: Xuất khẩu gạo đã chứng kiến sự tăng trưởng đáng kể trong suốt giai đoạn này.
items.explanation: "grew substantially" → "a substantial growth in".

items.prompt: Coal production dropped dramatically after 2000.
sampleAnswers: There was a dramatic drop in coal production after 2000.
items.promptVi: Sản lượng than đã sụt giảm nghiêm trọng sau năm 2000.
items.explanation: "dropped dramatically" → "a dramatic drop in".

targetStructures: There was a/an + adj + noun + in …
checklist: Trạng từ đổi thành tính từ (sharply → sharp)
Động từ đổi thành danh từ (increased → increase)
Giữ nguyên mốc thời gian

exercises.title: Homework 2 — Write 8 trend sentences
exercises.instruction: Turn the 8 answers of the matching exercise (A–C, C–D, D–E, E–G, G, G–L, J, L–N) into 8 complete sentences — each with your own figures and an adverb of degree.

stimulus.caption: Homework — đường biểu đồ A → N (8 đoạn: A–C, C–D, D–E, E–G, G, G–L, J, L–N)

targetStructures: rose / increased / climbed / grew / dropped / fell / declined / decreased / plunged / fluctuated
slightly / gradually / steadily / significantly / substantially / considerably / dramatically / sharply / steeply / slowly
There was a/an + adj + noun + in …
checklist: Mỗi câu có một trạng từ hoặc tính từ chỉ mức độ
Không dùng lại cùng một động từ xu hướng
Có số liệu cụ thể trong mỗi câu
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Gợi ý của sách (số liệu tự đặt):
1. Sales rose gradually from 200 to 350 units between 2000 and 2005.
2. The figure then dropped significantly to 150 units in 2006.
3. It remained stable at 150 units for the next two years.
4. Sales increased substantially to 600 units in 2010.
5. The figure reached a peak of 650 units in 2011.
6. After that, it fluctuated between 100 and 550 units.
7. It hit the lowest point of 100 units in 2014.
8. Finally, sales fell slowly from 400 to 320 units at the end of the period.

— Cách viết khác (số liệu tự đặt) —
1. (A–C) The figure rose gradually from 50 to 60.
2. (C–D) It then dropped significantly by 40 to just 20.
3. (D–E) After that, the figure remained relatively stable at 20 for a short period.
4. (E–G) This was followed by a substantial increase of 75 units.
5. (G) The figure climbed steeply to reach a peak of 95.
6. (G–L) Over the next stage, the number fluctuated considerably between 5 and 80.
7. (J) In the middle of this period, it plunged dramatically to hit the lowest point of only 5.
8. (L–N) Finally, the figure fell slowly by 10, from 50 to 40.

exercises.title: Practice 1 — Complete the sentences below using prepositions
exercises.instruction: Fill in each blank with a suitable preposition (the 22 sentences in the book). Preposition bank: at · to · by · of · in · with · from · between … and … · over · around.

items.explanation: "From … to …" hoặc "Between … and …" nêu khoảng thời gian; "a drop of 15%" — of + mức thay đổi.

items.prompt: GM car sales peaked ____ 2,000 in 1999.
items.explanation: "peak at + số" = đạt đỉnh ở mức.

items.prompt: The chart shows a decline ____ 35% ____ the bird population.
items.explanation: "a decline of + số" (mức giảm) + "in + đối tượng" (giảm ở cái gì).

items.prompt: There has been a significant increase ____ the number of people aged over eighty.
items.explanation: "an increase in + đối tượng".

items.prompt: There have been dramatic cuts ____ the level of spending on the elderly, reaching a low ____ 11%.
items.explanation: "cuts in + đối tượng"; "a low of + số" = mức thấp nhất là.

items.prompt: Profits rose ____ a low of 4.5 million to a high of 8 million in 2008.
items.explanation: "rise from A to B" — from đi với điểm xuất phát.

items.prompt: Canada’s and Australia’s wheat exports fluctuated ____ 5 million and 6 million, respectively.
items.explanation: "fluctuate around / at + số" = dao động quanh mức.

items.prompt: There were significant improvements ____ healthcare ____ 1980.
items.explanation: "improvements in + lĩnh vực"; "since 1980" = kể từ năm 1980.

items.prompt: The statistics show a reduction ____ 20% ____ energy costs as a result ____ the measures.
items.explanation: "a reduction of 20%" (mức giảm) "in energy costs" (giảm ở đâu); "as a result of" = do.

items.prompt: Profits fell ____ 10%, from 2,000 to 1,800, in the 1970s.
items.explanation: "fell by 10%" — by chỉ lượng thay đổi.

items.prompt: The radio station experienced a fall ____ 36,000 listeners to a total audience ____ 2.1 million.
items.explanation: "a fall of 36,000" (mức giảm); "a total audience of 2.1 million".

items.prompt: The number of students fell ____ a low of 1,500 in the second half of the year.
items.explanation: "fell to a low of" — to chỉ mức đạt tới.

items.prompt: Cases of the disease shot ____ from 2,400 in 1996 to 4,000 in 2004.
items.explanation: "shoot up" = tăng vọt (cụm động từ).

items.prompt: Demand reached a peak ____ 45,000 in early March.
items.explanation: "reach a peak of + số".

items.prompt: The number of cars sold remained unchanged in 1999 ____ three million.
items.explanation: "remain unchanged at + số" — at chỉ mức đứng yên.

items.prompt: Students do between three ____ four hours of homework a night.
items.explanation: "between three and four" — between luôn đi với and.

items.prompt: The number of accidents ____ 1999 was slightly higher than that of 2000.
items.explanation: "in 1999" — in + năm.

items.prompt: The figure rose steadily ____ the four years between 1997 ____ 2001.
items.explanation: "over the four years" = trong suốt 4 năm; "between 1997 and 2001".

items.prompt: Oil prices rose dramatically at first but then levelled out ____ $70 a barrel.
items.explanation: "level out at + số" = chững lại ở mức.

items.prompt: There was an increase ____ 50,000 between 1990 and 1992.
items.explanation: "an increase of 50,000" — of + lượng thay đổi sau danh từ.

items.prompt: ____ 1994 ____ 1997, sales rose steadily ____ over 20,000.
items.explanation: "From 1994 to 1997"; "rose to over 20,000" — to chỉ mức đạt tới.

items.prompt: DVD sales peaked ____ 60,000 ____ 1992 but then decreased ____ about 10,000 over the next two years.
items.explanation: "peaked at 60,000 in 1992"; "decreased by/to about 10,000" — by = giảm bao nhiêu, to = giảm xuống còn.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 — by or to?
exercises.instruction: Fill in by or to. Remember: BY = how much it rose/fell; TO = the level it reached.

items.prompt: The figure rose ____ 5% ____ 45% in 2010.
items.explanation: BY = tăng thêm bao nhiêu (5 điểm phần trăm); TO = đạt tới mức nào (45%).

items.prompt: Sales fell ____ 2,000 units in the final year, reaching 8,000.
items.explanation: Mức đích đã có ở “reaching 8,000” → 2,000 là mức giảm → BY.

items.prompt: The population increased ____ 12 million by 2020.
items.explanation: 12 triệu là mức dân số đạt tới (vào năm 2020) → TO. “by 2020” ở đây nghĩa là “tính đến năm 2020”.

items.prompt: There was a drop ____ 300 tonnes ____ 1,200 tonnes.
items.explanation: Sau danh từ “a drop” dùng OF cho mức giảm (300 tấn); TO cho mức cuối (1,200 tấn).

items.prompt: The rate climbed ____ 3 percentage points ____ 19%.
items.explanation: BY cho mức tăng (3 điểm %), TO cho đích đến (19%).

exercises.title: Practice 2 — Rewrite using the structures learnt
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each sentence starting with the word given, using one of the 3 trend structures.

items.prompt: The number of cars fell gradually over the period from 1990 to 2000.
sampleAnswers: The number of cars experienced a gradual fall from 1990 to 2000.
The number of cars experienced a gradual fall over the period from 1990 to 2000.
items.promptVi: Số lượng ô tô đã giảm dần trong suốt giai đoạn từ năm 1990 đến năm 2000.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc 2: S + experienced + a/an + adj + noun → "experienced a gradual fall".

items.prompt: The research investment decreased significantly in 2005.
sampleAnswers: The year 2005 witnessed a significant decrease in research investment.
items.promptVi: Năm 2005 chứng kiến sự sụt giảm đáng kể trong đầu tư nghiên cứu.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc 3: mốc thời gian làm chủ ngữ + witnessed + adj + noun + in.

items.prompt: There was a slight fall in the sales of mangos in 2006.
sampleAnswers: The sales of mangoes fell slightly in 2006.
The sales of mangos fell slightly in 2006.
items.promptVi: Doanh số bán xoài đã giảm nhẹ vào năm 2006.
items.explanation: Ngược về cấu trúc 1: S + V + adv → "fell slightly".

items.prompt: The number of organic products in supermarkets has increased sharply.
sampleAnswers: There has been a sharp increase in the number of organic products in supermarkets.
items.promptVi: Số lượng sản phẩm hữu cơ trong siêu thị đã tăng mạnh.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc "There has been a sharp increase in…" — giữ thì hiện tại hoàn thành của câu gốc.

items.prompt: There was a quick drop of 3 million USD in sugar imports in 1988.
sampleAnswers: 1988 saw a quick drop of 3 million USD in sugar imports.
items.promptVi: Năm 1988 chứng kiến sự sụt giảm nhanh chóng 3 triệu USD trong lượng đường nhập khẩu.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc 3: "1988 saw a quick drop of … in …".

items.prompt: The price of laptops dropped quickly over the period.
sampleAnswers: A quick drop in the price of laptops was seen over the period.
A quick drop was seen in the price of laptops over the period.
items.promptVi: Một sự sụt giảm nhanh chóng đã được ghi nhận ở giá laptop trong suốt giai đoạn này.
items.explanation: Bị động: "A quick drop in … was seen over the period".

items.prompt: There was an upward trend in the number of visitors to the website.
sampleAnswers: The number of visitors to the website increased steadily.
The number of visitors to the website experienced an upward trend.
items.promptVi: Số lượng lượt truy cập trang web đã trải qua xu hướng đi lên.
items.explanation: "an upward trend" = tăng đều → "increased steadily".

items.prompt: The growth rate fluctuated wildly throughout the years.
sampleAnswers: There were wild fluctuations in the growth rate throughout the years.
There was a wild fluctuation in the growth rate throughout the years.
items.promptVi: Tốc độ tăng trưởng đã trải qua những biến động mạnh trong suốt những năm đó.
items.explanation: "fluctuated wildly" → "There were wild fluctuations in…".

items.prompt: The number of students applying to the university stabilized over the decade.
sampleAnswers: A period of stability was seen in the number of students applying to the university over the decade.
A stability was seen in the number of students applying to the university over the decade.
items.promptVi: Số lượng học sinh nộp đơn vào trường đại học đã duy trì sự ổn định trong suốt thập kỷ qua.
items.explanation: "stabilized" → "A period of stability was seen in…".

items.prompt: The year 2000 saw a gradual growth in the house price in London.
sampleAnswers: The house price in London grew gradually in 2000.
items.promptVi: Giá nhà ở London đã tăng từ từ vào năm 2000.
items.explanation: Ngược về cấu trúc 1: "grew gradually".

targetStructures: There was a/an + adj + noun + in …
checklist: Bắt đầu đúng bằng từ cho sẵn
Đổi đúng adverb ⇄ adjective
Giữ nguyên số liệu và mốc thời gian

exercises.title: Exercise 5 — Three versions of the same trend
exercises.instruction: For each set of data, write 3 sentences using Structure 1, 2 and 3 in turn.

stimulus.caption: Ba bộ dữ liệu xu hướng
rows: Hành khách đi tàu ở Nhật
Lượng giấy tái chế ở Đức
Tỷ lệ thất nghiệp ở Tây Ban Nha

targetStructures: There was a/an + adj + noun + of … to … in …
S + saw / witnessed / experienced + a/an + adj + noun
checklist: Mỗi bộ dữ liệu có đủ 3 câu, mỗi câu một cấu trúc
Dùng đúng BY cho mức thay đổi và TO cho giá trị đích
Dùng AMOUNT cho giấy tái chế, PERCENTAGE cho tỷ lệ thất nghiệp
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Dữ liệu 1:
(C1) The number of train passengers in Japan increased dramatically by 12 million to 20 million between 2005 and 2015.
(C2) There was a dramatic increase of 12 million in the number of train passengers in Japan between 2005 and 2015.
(C3) Japan saw a dramatic increase of 12 million in the number of train passengers from 2005 to 2015.

Dữ liệu 2:
The amount of recycled paper in Germany decreased significantly by 3 million tonnes to 3 million tonnes between 1990 and 2000.
There was a significant decrease of 3 million tonnes in the amount of recycled paper in Germany from 1990 to 2000.
Germany saw a significant decrease in the amount of paper recycled, from 6 million tonnes in 1990 to 3 million tonnes in 2000.

Dữ liệu 3:
The unemployment rate in Spain rose sharply by 18 percentage points to 26% between 2008 and 2013.
There was a sharp rise of 18 percentage points in the unemployment rate in Spain over this period.
Spain experienced a sharp rise in its unemployment rate, from 8% in 2008 to 26% in 2013.

exercises.title: Warm-up — Multiples
exercises.instruction: Fill in a suitable word to express the multiple.

items.prompt: The rate rose from 20% to 40%. It ____ over the period.
items.explanation: x2 → double (động từ).

items.prompt: Sales went from 100 to 300 units, so they ____.
items.explanation: x3 → treble / triple.

items.prompt: The figure grew from 5 to 20 million, meaning it ____.
items.explanation: x4 → quadruple.

items.prompt: There was a ____ increase in car ownership (from 10 to 20 million).
items.explanation: Dạng tính từ của x2.

items.prompt: There was a ____ rise in tourist numbers (from 2 to 6 million).
items.explanation: Dạng tính từ của x3.

items.prompt: The figure for China was six ____ higher than that for Vietnam.
items.explanation: x times higher / greater than…

items.prompt: The UK consumed 1,000 tonnes, ____ the amount eaten in the US (2,000 tonnes).
items.explanation: half the amount = một nửa.

exercises.title: Extra practice — One figure, four ways to express a multiple
exercises.instruction: Data: A = 10 million (1992) → 20 million (1998). Write 4 sentences expressing the same idea in 4 different ways.

items.prompt: Dùng động từ “double”
sampleAnswers: The figure for A doubled from 10 million in 1992 to 20 million in 1998.
items.promptVi: Số liệu cho mục A đã tăng gấp đôi từ 10 triệu vào năm 1992 lên 20 triệu vào năm 1998.
items.explanation: "double" = tăng gấp đôi; "from … in 1992 to … in 1998".

items.prompt: Dùng “-fold”
sampleAnswers: There was a two-fold increase in A, from 10 million to 20 million, between 1992 and 1998.
items.promptVi: Đã có sự gia tăng gấp đôi ở mục A, từ 10 triệu lên 20 triệu, trong khoảng thời gian từ năm 1992 đến năm 1998.
items.explanation: "a two-fold increase in" = mức tăng gấp hai lần.

items.prompt: Dùng “times … as many as”
sampleAnswers: In 1998, the figure for A was twice as many as that in 1992.
items.promptVi: Vào năm 1998, số liệu cho mục A nhiều gấp đôi so với năm 1992.
items.explanation: "twice as many as that in 1992" — "that" thay cho "the figure".

items.prompt: Dùng “by” và “to”
sampleAnswers: A increased by 10 million to 20 million over the six-year period.

A: Starting at about 95,000 in 1960, the number of Internet users fell sharply to around 30,000 in 1980 before levelling off at roughly 20,000–25,000 until 2010.
B: The figure rose rapidly from 20 to 95 between 1960 and 1980, and then it remained stable at this level until 2010.
C: The number of users increased steadily from about 10 in 1960 and then continued its upward trend, reaching a peak of about 105 in 2010.
D: The bird population declined from about 95,000 in 1960 to a low of 20,000 in 1990, but later recovered to 70,000 in 2010.
E: The figure dropped dramatically from 95 to 20 between 1960 and 1980, followed by a period of stability at around 15.
F: The bird population fluctuated wildly, hitting lows of about 10 in 1970 and 15 in 1990 before rising to a peak of about 105 in 2010.

— Cách viết khác —
1. (A) Starting at about 95,000 in 1960, the number of Net users fell dramatically to around 30,000 in 1980, before declining only slightly and ending at 20,000 in 2010.
2. (B) The number of Net users rose sharply from 20 in 1960 to 95 in 1980, but later remained stable at this level until 2010.
3. (C) The number of Net users increased steadily from just 10 in 1960 to 100 in 2000, and then it continued its upward trend, reaching a peak of 105 in 2010.
4. (D) There was a steady decline in the bird population from 95,000 in 1960 to 60,000 in 1980, which was followed by a sharp drop to a low of 20,000 in 1990; however, the figure then recovered to 70,000 by 2010.
5. (E) The bird population fell slightly from 95 to 80 between 1960 and 1970 before plummeting to 20 in 1980, after which it levelled off at around 15 for the rest of the period.
6. (F) Starting at 85 in 1960, the bird population plunged to 10 in 1970, rebounded to 70 in 1980 and dropped again to 15 in 1990, before surging to a peak of 105 in 2010.

exercises.instruction: The graph below shows the consumption of fast food in the UK (grams per person per week) from 1970 to 1990. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

rubric.sampleAnswer:
The line graph illustrates how much fast food people in the UK ate per week, measured in grams per person, between 1970 and 1990.

Overall, while the consumption of fish and chips and hamburgers rose significantly, the reverse pattern could be seen in pizza consumption. It is also clear that fish and chips became the most popular fast food by the end of the period.

Fish and chips and hamburgers both showed an upward trend. In 1970, people ate about 75 grams of fish and chips per week, and this figure rose gradually to 150 grams in 1980 before surging to 300 grams in 1985 and 500 grams in 1990. Hamburger consumption followed a similar pattern, climbing slowly from 30 grams to 120 grams in 1985 and then more than doubling to around 280 grams in 1990.

By contrast, pizza was the most popular fast food in 1970, at about 310 grams. However, its consumption fell steadily to a low of 200 grams in 1985, having been overtaken by fish and chips in the early 1980s, and it was later overtaken by hamburgers as well. The figure then rose slightly to about 220 grams in 1990.

exercises.title: PART A1 — Trend vocabulary

items.prompt: Tăng nhẹ

increase slightly / a slight increase
grow slightly / a slight growth

sampleAnswers: surge / a surge
rocket / a surge
jump / a jump
items.explanation: Tăng vọt: "surge" vừa là động từ vừa là danh từ.

sampleAnswers: plunge / a plunge
plummet / a plummet
drop sharply / a sharp drop

items.prompt: Ổn định trở lại sau khi tăng
sampleAnswers: level off / a levelling off
level out / a levelling out
stabilise / a period of stability

oscillate / an oscillation
vary / a variation

Danh từ có mạo từ a/an + tính từ nếu cần

exercises.title: PART A2 — Prepositions
exercises.instruction: Fill in a suitable preposition. 1 point each.

items.prompt: The figure increased ____ 2,000 units in 2010.
items.explanation: "increased by 2,000" = tăng thêm; "increased to 2,000" = tăng lên mức.

items.prompt: Sales rose ____ 5% ____ 25% over the period.
items.explanation: "rose from 5% to 25%" hoặc "rose by 5% to 25%".

items.prompt: The number of visitors peaked ____ 40,000 in July.
items.explanation: "peak at + số".

items.prompt: There was a fall ____ 300 tonnes ____ rice exports.
items.explanation: "a fall of 300 tonnes" (lượng giảm) "in rice exports" (giảm ở đâu).

items.prompt: The rate remained stable ____ 12%.
items.explanation: "remain stable at + số".

items.prompt: Prices fluctuated ____ 10 USD ____ 15 USD.
items.explanation: "fluctuate between A and B".

items.prompt: The population reached a peak ____ 9 million.
items.explanation: "reach a peak of + số".

items.prompt: The figure hit a low ____ 2,000.
items.explanation: "hit a low of + số".

items.prompt: He won the election ____ 52% of the vote.
items.explanation: "with 52% of the vote" = với 52% số phiếu.

items.prompt: The figure rose steadily ____ the four years ____ 1997 ____ 2001.
items.explanation: "over the four years between 1997 and 2001" (hoặc from … to …).

exercises.title: PART A3 — Rewrite the sentences
exercises.instruction: Rewrite each sentence using the word in brackets, keeping the same meaning. 2 points each.

items.prompt: The number of tourists rose sharply in 2012.
sampleAnswers: There was a sharp rise in the number of tourists in 2012.

sampleAnswers: Coal production declined gradually.

items.prompt: Rice exports fell dramatically in 2008.

items.explanation: "The year 2008 witnessed a dramatic fall in…".

sampleAnswers: There was a two-fold increase in the figure between 1990 and 1995.
The figure saw a two-fold increase between 1990 and 1995.
items.explanation: "doubled" → "a two-fold increase in".

items.prompt: A was 60% and B was 20%.
sampleAnswers: The figure for A was 60%, which was three times higher than that for B, at 20%.
A, at 60%, was three times higher than B, at 20%.
items.explanation: 60% = 3 × 20% → ", which was three times higher than that for B".

targetStructures: There was a/an + adj + noun + in …
checklist: Giữ nguyên nghĩa và số liệu
Dùng đúng từ gợi ý

exercises.title: PART A4 — Link two trends
exercises.instruction: Link each pair of trends into ONE sentence, using a different structure each time (followed by / before V-ing / but later + V / Starting at …). 2.5 points each.

sampleAnswers: The figure rose from 100 to 400 between 2000 and 2010 before falling to 250 in 2020.
Starting at 100 in 2000, the figure quadrupled to 400 in 2010, before falling to 250 in 2020.

exercises.title: PART B — Full essay
exercises.instruction: The table below shows the number of visitors to three museums in London between 2005 and 2020 (millions). Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

stimulus.caption: Number of visitors to three museums in London, 2005–2020 (millions)
stimulus.note: Introduction paraphrase (10đ) · Overview 2 đặc điểm, không số liệu (15đ) · Body chia hợp lý, 8–10 số liệu (15đ) · Từ vựng xu hướng & cấu trúc (10đ) · Ngữ pháp (10đ)

targetStructures: the opposite trend was true for

scoring.criterion: Task Achievement — đủ 4 đoạn, có Overview không số liệu, chọn lọc số liệu
Coherence & Cohesion — chia đoạn theo năm chuyển giao, từ nối đa dạng
Lexical Resource — từ vựng xu hướng, mức độ, phần trăm
Grammatical Range & Accuracy — đặc biệt là chuyển thì quá khứ → tương lai

checklist: Introduction paraphrase, không chép đề
Overview 2 câu, không số liệu
Đổi thì đúng tại năm chuyển giao
Không dùng “There were” với phần trăm
Tối thiểu 150 từ
rubric.sampleAnswer:
The table gives information about the number of people who visited three museums in London between 2005 and 2020.

Overall, while visitor numbers at all three museums rose in the first ten years, they all fell dramatically in 2020. The British Museum was the most popular museum throughout the period.

In 2005, the British Museum attracted 4.5 million visitors, compared to 3.9 million for the Tate Modern and only 2 million for the Science Museum. Over the next five years, all three figures increased, reaching 5.8 million, 5.1 million and 2.8 million, respectively.

From 2010 onwards, the trends were different. Visitor numbers at the British Museum continued to grow to a peak of 6.8 million in 2015, and the Science Museum also rose to 3.4 million. By contrast, the Tate Modern saw a slight fall to 4.7 million. In 2020, however, all three museums experienced a sharp drop, with the figures falling to just 1.3 million, 1 million and 0.9 million, respectively.

exercises.instruction: Write one Introduction sentence for each task, using the method given in brackets (PP1 / PP2 / PP3).

items.prompt: The chart shows the participation of young people in sports by gender in Great Britain in 1999. (PP2)

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Combine two sentences with while / whereas
exercises.instruction: Combine the two sentences into ONE Overview sentence using while or whereas (Formula 3). Watch the comma and keep both clauses parallel.

items.prompt: Overall, sales of laptops rose. Sales of desktop computers fell.
sampleAnswers: Overall, while sales of laptops rose, sales of desktop computers fell.
Overall, sales of laptops rose, whereas sales of desktop computers fell.

exercises.title: Exercise 4 — Which Overview is acceptable?
exercises.instruction: Mark each Overview ✔ or ✘.

items.prompt: “Overall, the number of cars rose from 5 million to 15 million.”
items.explanation: ✘ — có số liệu. Overview tuyệt đối không có số liệu.

items.prompt: “It is clear that all three figures increased over the period. Additionally, chicken was by far the most popular meat.”
items.explanation: ✔ — hai đặc điểm rõ ràng, không số liệu (Công thức 1).

items.prompt: “The chart shows information about four countries.”

items.prompt: “Overall, while the figures for A and B declined steadily, that for C showed the opposite trend.”
items.explanation: ✔ — Công thức 3, hai vế song song (cùng là xu hướng).

items.prompt: “Overall, while A increased, B was the highest.”
items.explanation: ✘ — hai vế không song song (một vế là xu hướng, một vế là thứ hạng).

items.prompt: “In general, women outnumbered men in most years, whereas the figure for men was far more volatile.”

Phần dự báo (sau 2020) dùng is expected / is projected / is likely to
Có ít nhất một câu so sánh USA với Japan
rubric.sampleAnswer: In 1940, 9% of Americans were aged 65 or over, compared to just 5% of the Japanese population. Over the following 80 years, the American figure rose gradually to around 14%, whereas the proportion in Japan remained low until 2000. From 2020 onwards, the percentage of elderly Americans is projected to climb to 23% by 2040, while the figure for Japan is expected to rocket to about 27%.

exercises.title: Exercise 5 — Write the Body from an outline (fast food, strategy 1)
exercises.instruction: Using the outline (fast food task, strategy 1 — by trend direction), write the two complete Body paragraphs.

stimulus.caption: Dàn ý — Consumption of fast food in the UK, 1970–1990
rows: Câu chủ đề: fish and chips và hamburgers đều tăng · fish and chips: 75 g (1970) → 150 g (1980) → tăng vọt lên 300 g (1985) → 500 g (1990), cao nhất · hamburgers: 30 g → 120 g (1985) → 280 g (1990)
Câu chủ đề: pizza theo xu hướng ngược lại · cao nhất năm 1970 (≈ 310 g) · giảm xuống 200 g (1985), bị fish and chips (≈ 1982) và hamburgers (≈ 1988) vượt · tăng nhẹ lên 220 g (1990)

checklist: Mỗi đoạn mở bằng câu chủ đề
Giữ một chiến lược (theo chiều xu hướng) cho cả hai đoạn
Nhắc hai điểm giao cắt ở Body 2
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Fish and chips and hamburgers both showed an upward trend. In 1970, people ate about 75 grams of fish and chips per week, and this figure rose gradually to 150 grams in 1980 before surging to 300 grams in 1985 and 500 grams in 1990. Hamburger consumption followed a similar pattern, climbing slowly from 30 grams to 120 grams in 1985 and then more than doubling to around 280 grams in 1990.

By contrast, pizza was the most popular fast food in 1970, at about 310 grams. However, its consumption fell steadily to a low of 200 grams in 1985, having been overtaken by fish and chips in the early 1980s, and it was later overtaken by hamburgers as well. The figure then rose slightly to about 220 grams in 1990.

exercises.instruction: The graph below shows the number of university graduates in Canada from 1992 to 2007. Write a complete essay (4 paragraphs, 160–190 words). State the grouping strategy you chose at the top of your essay.

stimulus.caption: University graduates, Canada, 1992–2007

targetStructures: Overall, … It is also clear that …
which was still far lower than
checklist: Ghi chiến lược gom nhóm ở đầu bài
Overview: cả hai giới tăng (mạnh nhất sau 2001); nữ luôn cao hơn nam
Năm nổi bật ≈ 2001 chia hai đoạn Body
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Chiến lược: 3 — theo mốc thời gian (năm nổi bật ≈ 2001).

The line graph illustrates how many men and women graduated from universities in Canada between 1992 and 2007.

Overall, the number of graduates of both sexes rose over the period, with the most significant growth after 2001. It is also clear that women outnumbered men in every year.

Between 1992 and 2001, the figures for both sexes changed very little. The number of female graduates rose slightly from about 98,000 to a high of around 104,000 in 1996, before falling back to approximately 100,000 at the end of the 1990s. Similarly, the number of male graduates fluctuated between roughly 70,000 and 76,000 during this time.

From 2001 onwards, however, both figures increased considerably. The number of women graduating climbed steadily to about 125,000 in 2004 and then rose dramatically to nearly 150,000 in 2007. Over the same period, the number of male graduates grew from about 73,000 to approximately 95,000, which was still far lower than the figure for women.
